mainEntity.name: How important are customer reviews for Google Business Profile ranking and visibility?

acceptedAnswer.text: Customer reviews are extremely important for both Google Business Profile ranking and overall business visibility. Google's algorithm considers the quantity, quality, and recency of reviews as a significant factor in local search rankings. Businesses with numerous positive reviews are often ranked higher and appear more prominently. Furthermore, reviews build trust and credibility with potential customers, influencing their decision-making. Responding to reviews, both positive and negative, also demonstrates excellent customer service and further boosts your profile's appeal and engagement signals to Google.
acceptedAnswer.description: Customer reviews are critical; Google's algorithm heavily weighs quantity, quality, and recency for local ranking. They also build trust and credibility with potential customers.
